article.title: -지 않아도 되다 no obligación
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
article.chapter: Deseo, obligación, permiso y capacidad — 희망·의무·허가·능력

claims.summary: The NIKL grammar report explicitly states that the negative forms of **-어도 되다** are **-지 않아도 되다** and **안 -어도 되다**; it illustrates both with **밥을 먹지 않아도 돼요**, **커피를 마시지 않아도 돼요**, and **커피를 안 마셔도 돼요**. It distinguishes these as permission not to perform an action (absence of obligation) from **-(으)면 안 되다**, which expresses prohibition. The distinction is contextual: “no tienes que” does not mean “está prohibido”.

locator.label: Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 2), PDF pp. 491–492 (printed pp. 483–484): sentence-structure information and examples for -지 않아도 되다 / 안 -어도 되다; contrast with -(으)면 안 되다.

links.notes: La fuente oficial explicita ambas formas negativas, ejemplos y contraste con prohibición.
